rationale: The held 45 FR 44249 text confirms EO 12221 (1980-06-27): it rewrites Section 8 of EO 12044 to read 'Unless extended this Order expires on April 30,1981.' The held text of EO 12291 section 10 (1981-02-17) revokes 'Executive Orders No. 12044, as amended, and No. 12174', with no delayed effect for that section, so the amended sunset ended on 1981-02-17, before its own date. A literal search of the held texts for 12221 found no other reference to the order, so no earlier end was found. The dates, mechanism, basis and gaps are consistent.
